final_adjudication.notes: Final adjudication is intentionally pending. Reviewer decisions are recorded separately and never overwrite the original labels in queries.jsonl or metadata.json.

limitations: The dataset remains diagnostic-only until a second reviewer confirms labels or the project explicitly accepts single-reviewer status.
The three approved local files are the only allowed source corpus for this version.
Python-news remains excluded until a byte-identical, hash-verified snapshot is archived and explicitly approved.
The original queries.jsonl and metadata.json were preserved and not modified.
